name: productivity-skills
description: Cloud GTD workflows for Codex through the connected Supabase tool, plus native macOS Calendar and Reminders.

interface.shortDescription: Cloud GTD plus native macOS Calendar and Reminders.
interface.longDescription: Use the connected Supabase tool to capture and process GTD inbox items, review linked projects and actions, and select feasible work with shared status rules. Create a GTD database, or bind an existing one on a new computer, with the user-invoked setup skill. The setup skill can also turn on agent captures, which let agents add inbox items when a task waits on the user. Keep the GTD binding, a private project reference and owner UUID, outside repositories. Manage native macOS Calendar and general Reminders through their separate skills.
defaultPrompt: Add a reminder to buy groceries tomorrow.
